name: Colour Balance
description: Exposure, contrast, brightness, saturation, vibrance, tint, per-hue saturation and dither, applied in display brightness (gamma 2.2) with optional far values that fade in with distance.

params.label: Exposure
params.doc: Brightness in stops; each stop doubles the light.

params.label: Contrast
params.doc: -1 is the flattest curve, 0 leaves the picture as it is, 1 is the steepest. Black and white stay put.

params.label: Brightness
params.doc: Lifts or lowers the picture, strongest in the shadows.

params.label: Saturation
params.doc: Colour strength of the whole picture.

params.label: Vibrance
params.doc: Boosts the colours that are least saturated and leaves strong colours alone.

params.label: Tint
params.doc: Moves the picture from green at -1 to magenta at 1.

params.label: Red saturation
params.doc: Saturation of red colours only; negative values calm the colour, positive ones push it.

params.label: Yellow saturation
params.doc: Saturation of yellow colours only.

params.label: Green saturation
params.doc: Saturation of green colours only.

params.label: Aqua saturation
params.doc: Saturation of aqua colours only.

params.label: Blue saturation
params.doc: Saturation of blue colours only.

params.label: Purple saturation
params.doc: Saturation of purple colours only.

params.label: Magenta saturation
params.doc: Saturation of magenta colours only.

params.label: Custom hue saturation
params.doc: Saturation of the colours around the custom hue.

params.label: Custom hue
params.doc: The centre of the custom hue, from 0 (red) round the colour wheel to 1.

params.label: Custom hue range
params.doc: How wide the custom hue is, as a fraction of the colour wheel.

params.label: Dither
params.doc: Adds fine noise that hides banding in smooth gradients.

params.label: Dither strength
params.doc: The noise strength in output levels.

params.label: Far values
params.doc: Uses the Far settings instead of the near ones in the distance. Needs the game's depth buffer.

params.label: Far start
params.doc: Depth value where the far settings start to fade in; lower is further away.

params.label: Far end
params.doc: Depth value where the far settings are fully in effect; nearer than this blends towards the near settings.

params.label: Far curve
params.doc: Shapes the blend between near and far; above 1 keeps the near settings longer.

params.label: Far exposure
params.doc: Exposure in the distance.

params.label: Far contrast
params.doc: Contrast in the distance.

params.label: Far brightness
params.doc: Brightness in the distance.

params.label: Far saturation
params.doc: Saturation in the distance.

params.label: Far vibrance
params.doc: Vibrance in the distance.
